title: Akron's perfect storm: freshest team meets injured opponents
summary: Akron (29-5, 10-game streak) gets 7 DAYS rest before tournament — maximum in the field. Faces Texas Tech with Toppin OUT (torn ACL, 21.8/10.8 gone, TTU D collapsed 31st→87th). title: Houston's home court advantage worth 3+ points through E8

title: Dybantsa explosion: 93 pts in 3 Big 12 tourney games, projected #1 pick
summary: AJ Dybantsa (25.3 PPG nationally leading scorer) averaged 31 PPG across 3 Big 12 tourney games. Projected #1 pick in June draft. But BYU lost Saunders (ACL) — D cratered to 177th. Can't outscore elite defenses without team D. Purdue (#2 O) forces ball from his hands in S16.
impact: Dybantsa is the tournament's highest individual ceiling (35+ PPG games possible). But BYU's D limits ceiling to S16 max. Ceiling = 65 PPG on his own isn't enough vs #2 offense.
bettingEdge: BYU +4 vs NC State first round • BYU vs Purdue S16 OVER ~155 • Dybantsa player props
